product.name: Harness AI
product.purpose: Standalone software-product development application with classic chat, provider modules, and Product Part / Cluster / Module architecture control.

rules.moduleBoundary: External access goes through each module facade.
rules.referenceOnly: CodeAI Hub can be used as reference material, but modules are written fresh.

productParts.name: Application Shell
productParts.purpose: Standalone Electron interface surface and Core supervisor/client. It owns no backend truth.

clusters.name: Electron Host
clusters.purpose: Desktop host lifecycle, Core process supervision/client bridge, and VS Code link opening. It must not compose Core or provider runtime modules in-process.

modules.name: App Bootstrap
modules.purpose: Electron lifecycle, window creation, and local app startup.

modules.name: Core Process Bridge
modules.purpose: Start, stop, restart, health-check, or connect to the local Core Runtime process through process contracts only.

modules.name: VS Code Link Opener
modules.purpose: Open absolute file links in Visual Studio Code.

clusters.name: Session Interface
clusters.purpose: Classic chat session surface and session chrome. It submits user input and renders Core read models only.

modules.name: Session Window
modules.purpose: Transcript/dialog layout, session chrome, next-session mode panel, and Core-provided localizedContent reveal.

modules.name: Input Controls
modules.purpose: Message input, Stop/Play controls, and busy/lock display.

modules.name: Session Telemetry
modules.purpose: Usage limits, context window, and provider/model status surfaces.

modules.name: Session Sidebar
modules.purpose: Workspace switcher, workspace session list, next-session mode entry, session rename, and Settings entry.

clusters.name: Settings Surface
clusters.purpose: Provider, localization, recovery, and session profile settings UI. It edits settings through Core contracts only.

modules.name: Provider Settings UI
modules.purpose: Provider cards, auth/model/reasoning controls.

modules.name: Localization Settings UI
modules.purpose: UI language and reasoning translation controls.

modules.name: Recovery Controls UI
modules.purpose: Core restart and recovery action surface.

modules.name: Profile Settings UI
modules.purpose: Profile Creator settings tab for session profile management.

clusters.name: Browser Localization
clusters.purpose: Renderer-local access to Core-provided localization runtime payloads.

modules.name: Browser Localization Provider
modules.purpose: Shared renderer localization provider and t(category, messageId, fallback) lookup boundary over Core-provided runtime payloads.

productParts.name: Core Runtime
productParts.purpose: Out-of-process long-running local authority for workspaces, sessions, orchestration, provider composition, settings, localization, and workspace truth.

clusters.name: Runtime Process
clusters.purpose: Out-of-process Core Runtime server lifecycle and process contracts.

modules.name: Core Runtime Process
modules.purpose: Core process entrypoint plus health, status and shutdown process contracts.

clusters.name: Workspace Architecture
clusters.purpose: Workspace registry, product tree storage, skeleton materialization, and file-link contracts.

modules.name: Workspace Registry
modules.purpose: Known workspaces and active workspace selection.

clusters.name: Session Runtime
clusters.purpose: Session metadata, next-session mode truth, JSONL history, turn state, and UI snapshots.

modules.name: Session Registry
modules.purpose: Session metadata, create/open/rename operations.

modules.name: Session Request Handler
modules.purpose: Core-owned create/resume/send/stop routing, provider dispatch, and next-session mode truth for session actions.

modules.name: Provider Session Binding
modules.purpose: Map Core sessions to provider session ids and binding state.

modules.name: Session Event Stream
modules.purpose: Provider-neutral Core session events for Application Shell projections.

modules.name: Session Snapshot Projector
modules.purpose: Read model for the Electron session UI.

modules.name: Session Reasoning Display
modules.purpose: Project provider-visible reasoning/thinking into Core dialog messages.

clusters.name: Session Profiles
clusters.purpose: Runtime-selectable session profile truth: user-editable profile documents, catalog/selection with the virtual Native profile, provider-neutral payload materialization, and profile authoring.

modules.name: Profile Store
modules.purpose: User-editable session profile documents on disk: Profiles root resolution, document layout, and the shared profile type model.

modules.name: Profile Catalog
modules.purpose: Profile selection truth: catalog read models, virtual Native profile, per-provider applicability, and session-creation resolution with structured errors.

modules.name: Profile Materializer
modules.purpose: Provider-neutral session profile payload: applied prompt with the system wrapper, effective tooling categories, and applied-content hash.

modules.name: Profile Authoring
modules.purpose: Profile creation and editing truth: document templates, create-profile operation with derived ids, and editor path resolution.

clusters.name: Provider Network Capture
clusters.purpose: Local dev-time capture of a provider's native HTTPS request (system prompt + tool schemas) via a capture-and-abort proxy, without forwarding upstream; produces readable reference dumps.

modules.name: Capture Artifacts
modules.purpose: Capture type model, credential-header redaction, provider-neutral section extraction, and the JSONL + readable markdown artifact writer.

modules.name: Capture Certificates
modules.purpose: Diagnostic CA and per-host leaf certificates for the capture proxy's TLS termination, plus the env hints that make a provider client trust the CA for the capture run only.

modules.name: Capture Proxy
modules.purpose: Capture-and-abort MITM CONNECT proxy that terminates TLS with a diagnostic cert, reads the provider's full request, filters the target endpoint, and aborts before any upstream forward.

modules.name: Capture Orchestrator
modules.purpose: Command-level orchestration of native request capture: wires the certificate store, capture proxy and artifact writer, invokes the provider adapter capture through the proxy, and returns the artifact paths.

clusters.name: Universal Client
clusters.purpose: Core-owned universal client for OpenAI-shape providers (Kimi, GLM, Local Models, OpenRouter): the agent loop, tool registry and built-in tool execution, SSE + dialect streaming, and provider output-event mapping. Provider endpoints are thin Provider-Runtime modules on this core; MCP/skills/subagents are reserved extension points, not MVP.

modules.name: Client Contract
modules.purpose: Shared client contract types: turn request / messages / tool-calls, tool descriptor with a source abstraction (built-in now, MCP/skill reserved), per-provider dialect capability profile, client output-event and error model, and tool-name namespacing.

modules.name: Dialect Streaming
modules.purpose: Consolidated SSE + dialect layer: read data: frames, parse each OpenAI-shape chat.completions chunk into a normalized delta, accumulate tool calls by index, and normalize the provider thinking forms (reasoning_content / reasoning / think tags) onto one channel.

modules.name: Tool Registry
modules.purpose: Tool registry with a source abstraction: aggregate tool descriptors from sources (built-in now; MCP/skills reserved), route a tool call to its owning source, and expose a pass-through permission boundary (full-auto in MVP).

modules.name: Built-in Tools
modules.purpose: The built-in tool source: descriptors + executors for the MVP tool set (read_file, write_file, edit_file, apply_patch, exec_command, grep_files, glob_files; web tools in part 2), with workspace-path validation and process timeouts. Ported from the reference glm-native tool executors.

clusters.name: Settings And Localization
clusters.purpose: Settings persistence, UI localization runtime materialization, and visible reasoning translation overlay state.

modules.name: Settings Store
modules.purpose: Global and workspace settings persistence.

modules.name: Localization Runtime
modules.purpose: Approved source dictionaries, glossary protection, browser localization bootstrap, and materialized runtime bundle state.

modules.name: Reasoning Translation Overlay
modules.purpose: Visible reasoning translation policy, source hashing, pending state, sidecar overlays, and patch payloads.

productParts.name: Provider Runtime
productParts.purpose: Independent provider adapters, provider homes/auth, usage telemetry, and provider-backed translation engines composed by Core Runtime only.

clusters.name: Provider Registry
clusters.purpose: Provider catalog, invocation profile descriptors, model descriptors, and availability.

modules.name: Provider Registry
modules.purpose: Provider catalog, availability, and invocation profile descriptors.

modules.name: Provider Descriptor
modules.purpose: Model/reasoning capabilities and UI metadata.

clusters.name: Provider Readiness
clusters.purpose: Provider liveness, workspace provisioning readiness, and recovery status combination.

modules.name: Provider Readiness Registry
modules.purpose: Raw provider liveness and workspace provisioning state, readiness combination, and raw readiness change notifications.

modules.name: Provider Liveness Checker
modules.purpose: Provider liveness preflight helpers and env-isolated global-home adapter initialization.

modules.name: Provider Workspace Provisioner
modules.purpose: Provider-owned workspace home provisioning and raw per-workspace readiness state updates.

clusters.name: Provider Adapters
clusters.purpose: Independent provider adapter modules for every MVP provider. Application Shell must not instantiate them.

modules.name: Provider Adapter Contract
modules.purpose: Shared create/resume/send/subscribe/close adapter boundary used by Core.

modules.name: Claude Provider
modules.purpose: Claude provider adapter.

modules.name: Codex Provider
modules.purpose: Codex provider adapter.

modules.name: Kimi Provider
modules.purpose: Kimi provider adapter.

modules.name: GLM Native Provider
modules.purpose: GLM native provider adapter.

modules.name: GLM OpenCode Provider
modules.purpose: GLM OpenCode provider adapter.

modules.name: OpenRouter Provider
modules.purpose: OpenRouter provider adapter.

modules.name: Local Models Provider
modules.purpose: Local model provider adapter.

modules.name: Legacy Direct Provider Turn Runner
modules.purpose: Deprecated direct dispatch debt retained only until Core-owned provider dispatch replaces existing UI wiring.

clusters.name: Provider Home And Auth
clusters.purpose: Isolated provider homes, auth references, and ignored runtime files.

modules.name: Provider Home Manager
modules.purpose: Isolated provider home layout.

modules.name: Provider Auth Store
modules.purpose: API keys and auth references outside tracked workspace files.

clusters.name: Provider Events And Translation
clusters.purpose: Provider stream normalization, usage telemetry, and translation engines.

modules.name: Provider Event Normalizer
modules.purpose: Provider stream/event normalization.

modules.name: Usage Context Telemetry
modules.purpose: Usage limits and context-window signals.

modules.name: Provider Translation Engines
modules.purpose: Provider-backed UI/reasoning translation engines.
